earliest_observed_structural_redundancy.basis: AST-skeleton N_eff / candidate rows < 0.25 or top skeleton share > 0.25; this identifies redundancy only and is not evidence of signal-level collapse

first_signal_level_collapse.basis: the completed two-coordinate signal-sketch audit passed every fidelity gate and found no downstream concentration amplification

behaviour.definition: deterministic greedy all-pairs Pearson correlation clique >= 0.95 on pairwise >= 250 fixed-calendar train/development dates
